record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly set hidden/embedding width to 256, dropout to 0.2, learning rate to 0.0007 and maximum history to 64. Greater recurrent capacity may capture richer interests, while stronger dropout and a smaller step constrain overfitting; shorter histories reduce computation and retain most observed sequences. Preserve normalized tied embeddings, GRU depth, readout, scoring and loss. Retain seed 42, 200 batches/epoch and the 200-epoch cap; save dimensions and truncation for predictor consistency.
